linux-zflip3 pacman repository

The [zflip3] repository: Arch Linux Ports AArch64 packages for the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip3 (SM-F711N), built by GitHub Actions from the arch branch of linux-zflip3 (commit @ARCH_SHA@) in drzee-only Arch Linux Ports containers (ARMv8.2), with drzee's -march=armv8.2-a+fp16+rcpc+dotprod+crypto.

The repository is unsigned. In /etc/pacman.conf, after [core] and before [extra] (the phone's forks of extra packages keep their names and must win):

[zflip3]
SigLevel = Never
Server = https://mirror.funami.tech/linux-zflip3/arch/$arch
Server = @SITE_URL@/arch/$arch

Files: arch/aarch64/zflip3.db, package list, build hashes.
